name: Yuujo Gakuen
source:
Hero is going to become a priest. Once he breaks a statue of a "God" and the spirit of a girl appears from it. She asks to catch the spirit that dwells in the school building in exchange for lots of earthly pleasures.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-august-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
勇者即将成为一名牧师。某天，他打碎了一尊“神”的雕像，一个女孩的灵魂从中出现。她提出交换条件：只要勇者去捕捉寄宿在校舍中的灵魂，她就会给予他大量尘世的快乐。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-august-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
